meta.title: Web search
meta.description: Multi-backend search with explicit anonymous or key access, cost tiers, bounded retries and complete Web settings. Backends start disabled; account-backed requests may incur charges.

title: Web search
loadFailed: Could not load settings. Reload to try again.
saveUnconfirmed: Save could not be confirmed. Reload settings before saving again; do not assume the operation failed.
conflict: Saved configuration differs from your draft. Review the latest state before saving again.
actionFailed: The operation could not be confirmed. Search tests are never automatically replayed.
invalidField: Enter a valid value within the documented limits.
expectedRange: Enter a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}.
blockersTitle: This configuration will not search yet
blockNoBackends: No backend is enabled, so every search fails immediately.
blockSingleDisabled: Single-backend mode points at {{backend}}, which is disabled.
blockMissingCredential: Key mode without a stored credential: {{list}}.
backendIntro: Cost groups reflect the selected access mode. Modes are explicit: no automatic key selection, paid upgrade, or fallback.
unverifiedHelp: This backend has no verified API contract and cannot be enabled. An endpoint or credential does not make it supported.
anonymousNoCredential: Anonymous mode sends no credential; stored keys are not read.
credentialHelp: Secrets are write-only and are never returned to this page. Some references are read-only.
deleteCredentialConfirm: Delete this saved credential? This cannot be undone.
credentialFailed: Credential change could not be confirmed. The input has been cleared; inspect the current state before trying again.
testHelp: Each click sends one explicit test request using saved settings. Usage may be billed. Save changes first; failed tests are not automatically replayed by this page.
testNeedsBackend: Save an enabled backend first; tests only use saved configuration.
diagnosticsHelp: Recent request outcomes. Clearing diagnostics does not reset daily attempt budgets.
transferHelp: Export removes endpoint query strings and sensitive option values. Credential references are retained, but saved secrets are never included. Review imported endpoints and references before saving.
imported: Imported into the draft. Review and save to apply.
importFailed: Invalid JSON. Your current draft was kept.
defaultsConfirm: Replace your draft with defaults? Nothing is saved until you choose Save.
defaultsRestored: Defaults loaded into the draft. Save to apply.
help.mode: Run a single selected backend or the explicitly enabled backends in parallel.
help.singleBackend: Used only in single-backend mode; it must also be enabled.
help.maxResults: Maximum merged sources returned to the caller.
help.overallTimeoutMs: Deadline for the entire search, including retries.
help.language: Chosen from a fixed list. Each backend receives its own spelling (Brave zh-hans, Serper zh-cn, SearXNG zh-CN); backends that ignore the field say so.
help.region: Chosen from a fixed list of two-letter regions. Only backends that declare region support receive it, in their own format.
help.recency: Applied where supported by the selected API.
help.safeSearch: Request safer results where the backend supports it.
help.includeDomains: Comma-separated domains; leave empty for no allowlist.
help.dedup: Merge duplicates by normalized URL, or URL and title.
help.fusion: Combine ranking by reciprocal rank or preserve backend order.
help.retry.enabled: Configured HTTP retries can incur repeated charges. This page never replays a test action automatically.
help.retry.statuses: Only these response codes are retried, on the same backend and access mode.
help.retry.maxRetries: Additional attempts after the initial request.
help.retry.networkErrors: A failed response may still have incurred usage.
help.retry.timeouts: A timed-out request may still have incurred usage.
help.breaker.enabled: Temporarily pause a backend after repeated failures.
help.breaker.threshold: Failures required to open the circuit.
help.breaker.cooldownMs: Time before a backend can be attempted again.
help.cache.enabled: Reuse matching search results within the configured lifetime.
help.diagnostics.maxEntries: Limit the number of retained diagnostic records.
help.backend.enabled: Only explicitly enabled, verified backends can execute searches.
help.backend.mode: Choose a fixed anonymous or key mode. No automatic switching.
help.backend.endpoint: Use a trusted HTTPS endpoint, or a trusted local self-hosted endpoint. Never put secrets in the URL.
help.backend.credentialRef: Reference only, not the secret value. Save this reference before managing its credential.
help.backend.rateLimitPerMinute: Local attempt guard, not a provider billing guarantee.
help.backend.dailyAttemptLimit: Local daily attempt budget; retries also consume attempts.
testQueryPlaceholder: What should this backend look for?
activeTitle: This plugin is not the active search provider
activeOther: The web seam currently selects “{{provider}}”. Searches keep going there until this plugin is selected.
activateSelf: Use this plugin for web search
colorLegend: Green: free path, own account or self-hosted. Yellow: free allowance. Red: trial credits or paid. Sorted cheapest first.
credentialPending: Wait for the current action to finish.
credentialRefRequired: Set a credential reference name first.
credentialReadOnly: This reference is read-only: another source supplies its value, so the plugin cannot overwrite it. Pick a different reference name, such as DSH_SEARCH_X_SESSION.
